title: MarketLaneRatesPublished
description: goway-market's going prices for Uzbek lanes, read from freight offers: one whole snapshot. A newer version replaces every row of an older one, so a consumer keeps only the latest.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

version.description: The snapshot's number; it only grows. A consumer ignores a version at or below the one it holds.

computed_at.description: When the snapshot was computed. Prices older than the consumer's limit are not used.

window_weeks.description: Weeks of offers the prices could reach back.

rates.description: Region pairs inside Uzbekistan with enough offers of their own, per market vehicle class.

items.title: MarketLaneRate
items.description: The going trip price between two regions for one vehicle class.

origin_region_id.description: geo's region the loads leave from.

origin_area.description: The region's ISO 3166-2 code, for logs and people.

vehicle_class.description: goway-market's vehicle class (`fura`, `isuzu_5t`, `ref`, ...); each consumer maps it to its own classes.

per_km_uzs.description: Median so'm per km; null when no offer had a road distance.

route_km.description: Median road distance of the offers; null when none had one.

sample.description: Offers behind the price, reposts counted once.

curves.description: Every vehicle class's price by road distance, for lanes without enough offers of their own.

items.title: MarketClassCurve
items.description: A trip price of base_uzs + per_km_uzs × (km up to taper_after_km + taper_ratio × the km past it).

taper_ratio.description: Share of the per-km rate past taper_after_km; null means the full rate all the way.

low_ratio.description: 25th percentile of offer ÷ curve: the low end of the usual range.
